title: Support google gemini embedding model's title feature
body:
### Description

the gemini embeddings model allows passing titles with the created embedding for better retrieval embeddings. only valid when using taskType RETRIEVAL_DOCUMENT. but there is no way to currently pass this to google-vertex-embedding-model. i was wondering how we can support this?

see api: https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/docs/model-reference/text-embeddings-api

### AI SDK Version

_No response_

This issue requests support for a model-specific parameter ("title" for Gemini embeddings) in the agent's LLM provider integration, specifically affecting tool invocation and LLM operation. It directly relates to agent system behavior with LLM providers and model parameters.
